summary: Updates RFC 8138 by defining a bit in the RPL DODAG Configuration option that says whether compression is used in the RPL Instance, and specifies how nodes compliant with RFC 8138 behave when the bit is set or unset.

eli5.summary: A flag that tells all devices whether the shortened packet headers are in use, so they all handle packets the same way.

questions: rpl dodag configuration option compression bit
